title: Miscellaneous discharge measurements, in cubic feet per second, in the Pacific slope basins in California and Oregon, water year October 1951 to September 1952.
notes: One continuous listing with one printed header, split by basin subheadings (Tia Juana River basin; San Diego River basin; San Juan Creek basin; Santa Ana River basin) into four ruled blocks of 6, 4, 1 and 64 rows. Typed as one table, as the header is printed once; the subheadings are not typed (merged by Claude from the typist's four blocks, 2026-11-14). Typewriter-set. Dates give the month only when it changes. "do" printed without a period. Footnote letter a attached to one discharge (a33.4). Continues on the next page.
